item: Statistics: every stored version of a published figure (Lane M, R684)
summary: GET /api/stats/figures/vintages had no button: the figures table shows the latest vintage only, so a value a producer later revised was stored as evidence and unreachable. Each row now has a Versions > Show button that opens that one observation's trail under the table, oldest first, with the store's caveat visible beside it (R685). A change is shown only between two versions on the same unit, adjustment and base year; across a basis change it reads as a dash, never a difference of two quantities. One delegated listener; a language switch redraws it with no second request; a second click closes it; a fresh load forgets it. 5 strings in 12 languages. Feature ceiling down by 1.
